Gideon corrected himself to **280 seats** for Vantorre Group. The correction is in the July 1 thread in #strategic-pod.

He first said 300. A few minutes later he wrote that 300 was wrong, because he had been looking at a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The production roster showed 280 active seats as of July 1. That figure is the one to use in the QBR deck.
